page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.2xlarge is an instance in the High Clock Speed family built on KVM virtualization and the x86_64 architecture. It provides 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 4 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY processor cores running at a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The CPU configuration incorporates 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache. It includes support for hardware instructions including AVX-512 with VNNI, AES cryptography, and BMI2 bit manipulation. The instance is provisioned with 32.0 GB of memory, maintaining a 4.0 GB per vCPU ratio. No local instance storage is bundled, and network connectivity features a 2 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark testing places the instance solidly in the middle performance tier for general compute tasks, yielding a Geekbench single-core score of 1247.0 and a multi-core score of 4810.0, alongside a Passmark CPU score of 8999.79. Memory bandwidth tests demonstrate 427.07 GB/sec for small cached blocks and 49.41 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads, supporting a Passmark database operations score of 2977.09 and Redis SET throughput of 7.45 million operations per second. However, tests on larger machine learning workloads highlight clear architectural limitations: while lightweight 135M parameter LLM inference runs smoothly at 133.88 generation tokens per second, medium 7B models drop into the bottom 10 percent of benchmarks at 6.28 tokens per second due to the lack of hardware accelerators.

The 1:4 vCPU-to-memory configuration delivers a balanced profile for compute-driven enterprise tasks without the expense of specialized GPU or local NVMe arrays. Tradeoffs include reliance on external network storage for all persistence and lower baseline network throughput relative to larger cloud nodes. Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.2xlarge is well aligned for mid-tier relational databases, static web serving, software compilation pipelines, and transactional backend applications.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.2xlarge is a high clock speed virtual server configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of RAM on the x86_64 architecture. Powered by a 3.1 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor across 4 physical cores, the instance features AVX-512 extensions, 35 MB of L3 cache, and a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps, while including zero local disk storage. Benchmark evaluations reflect steady mid-range performance, producing a Passmark CPU score of 8999.79, a multi-core Geekbench score of 4810.0, and 7.45 million Redis SET operations per second. Lacking hardware accelerators, it struggles on larger AI inference tasks but provides reliable CPU density and memory throughput. This balance makes the instance appropriate for software compilation, web serving, in-memory caching, and relational database hosting.
